verdict: Yes. Palmonas pitched demi-fine jewellery on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal, with strong revenue. Demi-fine jewellery, usually gold-plated silver or brass, sits between cheap fashion jewellery and gold, and it's one of the fastest-growing jewellery segments.
angle: Young working women want jewellery they can wear every day without worrying. Demi-fine pieces use thicker plating and better materials than fashion jewellery. Anti-tarnish claims must be true, or reviews will hurt.
